mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed valuation multiples.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%) and moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL growth rate < 3.0%) indicates a sustainable economic expansion that supports equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL growth rate < 3.0%
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.0% and CPIAUCSL growth rate is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), higher discount rates reduce equity valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production level (INDPRO > 105.0) signals robust manufacturing output that correlates with rising corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts level (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to leading economic indicators.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate exceeding 1.5% annualized signals sustained economic expansion that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate exceeds 0.5% and UNRATE is below 4.0%.
